summary_1line: Guha fears Bharata’s army intends harm to Rama, mobilizes ferrymen to guard the Ganges, then approaches Bharata with gifts to gauge his intent.

image_candidates.scene_text: Guha stands on the Ganges bank watching Bharata’s vast army encamped across the shore, ordering armed boatmen to guard five hundred boats.
Lines of youthful ferrymen in armor hold spears beside moored boats along the misty Ganges at dusk.
Guha approaches Bharata’s camp carrying gifts of fish, flesh, and honey while a thousand kinsmen follow behind him.
